objective: Make Cloud IaC module release indexing a first-class fail-closed local Oya gate by binding OpenTofu module-registry-shaped namespace/name/system/version rows to the local module catalog, SHA-256 provenance inventory, provider-lock root, and provider-signature-review evidence while preserving no private registry API, service discovery, download endpoint, archive build, signing, SLSA, plan/apply, provider-resource-complete, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: The release index uses the module address dimensions namespace/name/system/version and records versions/download endpoint path shapes without claiming service discovery or endpoint implementation.
Rows remain local-path source metadata only; no remote module installer, archive package, ambient credentials, or registry download claim is made.
Reusable module release rows remain separate from provider configuration/runtime; provider evidence is referenced at the root lock/signature-review level only.
SLSA provenance remains an explicit future non-claim; this ChangeSet generates no SLSA attestation.

implemented_claims: Added oya gate validate cloud-iac-module-release-index with repo-local defaults for manifest, catalog, provenance, release-index, provider-lock root, and provider-signature-review paths.
Added release-index.json with six OpenTofu module-registry-shaped local rows for cloud-account, dns, k8s-namespace-bootstrap, kms, secrets-bootstrap, and vpc.

The gate verifies catalog/provenance/release-index module set coherence, OpenTofu module address and endpoint-path shape, file SHA-256 digest coherence with local bytes, provider evidence path existence, official-source anchors, and strict no-runtime/no-signing/no-SLSA policy booleans.
Manifest module_release_index_scope records release-index paths, module count/names, provider evidence refs, coherence guard, official sources, and explicit non-claims.
Run-all catalog membership now includes cloud-iac-module-release-index and focused tests cover the aggregate lane.
explicit_non_claims: no module signing, Sigstore, or cosign execution
no SLSA attestation generation or verification
no provider API calls or cloud resource provisioning
no live GitOps/ArgoCD/Kubernetes API/SLO/DR/capacity telemetry claim
false_green_findings_closed: A private-module-registry-shaped release surface can no longer be implied by prose-only catalog docs; it is now a machine-checkable local release index bound to catalog and provenance digests.
Module release rows cannot silently drift from catalog/provenance source paths, versions, evidence refs, file digests, or provider evidence refs.
Signed-module and SLSA claims fail closed because release rows and policy booleans must remain unsigned/not-generated for this slice.
The index records OpenTofu registry endpoint path shapes without pretending service discovery or download endpoints exist.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; aggregate run-all remains known-red on unrelated/concurrent application-shell compile drift in loop-recovery-patterns.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for actual private module registry service/discovery/download endpoints, module archive build, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA attestations, independent provider provenance/VSA verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, provider-resource-complete modules, private registry API, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.
